endorsements.name: Jelle Janssens
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1184
endorsements.description: A vulnerability was found in pihome-shc PiHome 1.77 and classified as critical. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /ajax.php?Ajax=GetModal_MQTTEdit. The manipulation of the argument id leads to sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
